critical_question: How does FlexGen turn memory offloading into a throughput advantage on a single small GPU, and what workload and latency trade-off limits that advantage?
source_locator: Sections 3-4 and 6.1, physical pages 3-6 and 8-9; Appendix A.4, physical pages 18 and 21-23.
expected_relation: Blockwise weight reuse and joint placement of weights, activations and KV cache enable larger effective batches that amortize I/O; compression can further reduce traffic. This benefits throughput-oriented generation with substantial host memory or storage, rather than establishing a universal low-latency serving improvement.
